autoconfig_n: {n} DOS/Windows game(s): launch config created automatically
bk_files_hint: Archives live in \\EMUELEC\Storage\backups — copy them to a PC via the network share for safekeeping.
bk_hint: Backs up only user data: games, saves, BIOS, configs, cheats and media. System files (system image, emulator cores, thumbnails) are excluded. Archives are stored at /storage/backups.
cf_apply_mode: Switch resolution now? If the screen goes black, wait or change back from this page.
cf_apply_raw: Apply the raw text to the table? (not saved to the device yet)
cf_backup: Start backup? The archive is stored on the same disk — copy it elsewhere afterwards.
cf_del_files: Delete {n} items? Folders are deleted recursively — cannot be undone!
cf_del_games: Delete {n} games? Files will be removed from the device permanently.
cf_del_pad: Delete all mappings of this gamepad?
cf_es_restart: Restart ES frontend? Settings changes take effect after the restart.
cf_restore_conf: Overwrite the current emuelec.conf with backup {f}?
cf_restore_input: Overwrite the current gamepad config with backup {f}?
cf_save_conf: Save emuelec.conf? (auto-backup; takes effect after ES restart)
cf_save_pads: Save gamepad mappings? (auto-backup; takes effect after ES restart)
cf_upgrade: Download and stage the {ch} update? It is applied on the next reboot (reboot manually from Power).
cf_upgrade_local: Use the EmuELEC update tarball already in /storage/.update (copied over the network)? A reboot applies it.
checking_long: Checking… (full MD5 verification, may take a while)
clean_upgrade_desc: Downloaded EmuELEC-*.tar update packages pile up in /storage/.update — any of them gets applied at boot. Removing stale ones frees space and avoids surprises.
core_default_hint: System default selected: to restore the default, delete the keys {s}.emulator and {s}.core in Settings → All Settings
dl_ia_hint: One login shared by all disc systems (Saturn / PSX / PS2). Free signup at archive.org.
dl_ia_no: archive.org account required for disc downloads (free signup)
dl_peers_hint2: Applied to every BT download (e.g. a PC seeding on your LAN)
dl_proxy_hint2: Required for archive.org (disc downloads) on some networks
dl_upload_hint: Share downloaded pieces back to other peers (default on)
dl_seed_hint: Keep seeding after a download finishes so other devices can fetch from this one (default on)
sec_token_hint: When set, every browser must enter this token to use the panel. Leave empty to disable.
auth_prompt: This panel is protected. Enter the access token (webmanager.token in Settings):
dl_port_hint: Inbound peer connections (forward it on your router for better swarm connectivity; default 6881)
drop_files: Drag & drop files here to upload
drop_games: Drag & drop game files here to upload to the current folder (multiple files; only {ext})
empty_dir: Folder is empty — drag files above to upload
fb_drop: Drag & drop .zip / .7z here to upload into /storage/roms/fbneo
fb_hint: Games come from the svcpcb torrent (archive.org). Tick the ones you want and download over BT, or upload .zip/.7z manually. Installed games are detected automatically.
fb_peer_hint: archive.org tracker and web seeds are unreachable from this box. Seed the same torrent on your PC and add its LAN address here.
missing_n: {n} files missing. Select the matching file to upload it to the required path.
overlay_hint: Pick the controller type that matches your pad.
pad_bind_hint: Each badge on the image is the key/button bound to that button; the table below holds the raw values.
pads_hint: (order = player 1/2/3… order; auto-backup before saving; takes effect after ES restart)
pads_readonly: (read-only view — edit mappings in ES: Main Menu → Controller Settings)
pads_warn: Warning: wrong mappings can make gamepads unusable in ES — restore a backup if that happens
power_hint: After changing settings, click 'Restart ES Frontend' to apply them — no full reboot needed.
restored_es: Restored; takes effect after ES restart
scrape_done: Scrape finished — found {found}, no match {notfound}, errors {errors}
scrape_nocreds: No ScreenScraper account saved — set it in the EmulationStation scraper first
title: EmuELEC Manager
upgrade_done: Upgrade finished — reboot to apply it.
upgrade_forced: Storage is {n} MB short of the pre-check — proceeding anyway.
upgrade_hint: The update is applied on reboot — reboot manually from Power when the download finishes.
upgrade_in_progress: Another upgrade is already running. Wait a minute and try again.
upgrade_local_hint: Too slow? Fetch EmuELEC-*.tar with a PC download manager, copy it to /storage/.update/ (network share \\EMUELEC\Update or the file manager), then "Install Downloaded Package".
upgrade_started: Upgrade started — progress is shown below.
video_warn: Note: selecting a mode your display does not support may cause a black screen. If that happens, recover in ES or change back from this page.
wifi_hint: Reboot required to take effect (the active connection will drop — edit with caution)
wifi_saved: WiFi settings saved; reboot to take effect
dl_residue: {n} leftover partial-download item(s), {s} — from failed/interrupted downloads
panel_upd_available: A new panel version is available
panel_upd_done: Panel updated — restarting, page will reload in a few seconds
panel_upd_hint: Replaced files are backed up under webmanager/backups/self-*; restore manually via SSH if something breaks.
cf_panel_upd: Update the panel from GitHub now? The panel restarts itself when done.
